notes: Background: mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B). Heavy realtime doc-search + assistant for support teams.
Trial summary (Hosted API): 2-week paid trial run across 4 routes (chat support, internal summarization, embeddings index refresh, reranker).
Traffic observed during trial: peak QPS ~22 for chat route during business hours; steady-state QPS ~7 across all routes.
Concurrency patterns: chat sessions avg 2.6 concurrent requests per active user; spikes up to 45 concurrent requests for short bursts during release windows.

Token mix (observed):
      - generation-heavy chat: avg 450 prompt tokens / 900 completion tokens per request
      - summarization: 1,200 input tokens -> 200 token summaries (batched)
      - embeddings: small texts, 64 tokens avg
      - reranking: short contexts (150 tokens) with 5 candidates each
Cost sensitivity: high. Looking to drop per-token unit cost 2.5x by moving to Dedicated + quantized model variants. Finance expects net TCO reduction within 6 months of Dedicated go-live.
Model preferences: prefer open checkpoints (Llama-family / mix-quantized variants) but need Redwood-verified performance numbers; fallback to hosted LLMs during maintenance windows.

SLA/security notes: must support SSO / SAML for admin console, audit logs retained 13 months, KMS integration required for key rotation; data residency requirement: EU + NA customer data separation for selected customers.
POC activities: SE-led benchmark (Liam) ran 48-hour simulator — measured p95 latency on chat route at 180ms for hosted baseline; target for Dedicated is p95 < 120ms at similar concurrency.

Dedicated sizing initial estimate (from trial telemetry):
      - baseline QPS target: 30 requests/sec aggregate
      - target concurrency (max sustained): 60 concurrent generation streams
      - token mix: 65% generation tokens, 25% embedding ops, 10% reranking/summarization
      - GPU footprint recommended: 3 x A100-80GB equiv for primary pool with 1 hot-standby node; consider mixed-precision quantized replicas for cost saving

Routing/fallback ask: automatic fallback to hosted API for overflow traffic above Dedicated capacity and during canary deploys. Need per-route fallback policies and token accounting visible in console.
Observability: request-level token breakdown, per-model cost attribution, and per-route latency heatmaps required. Redwood Console sample dashboard requested.
Customer quotes: 'We need predictable cost and no surprises at invoice time — token spikes on indexing runs killed us last quarter.'
Open technical questions: how KV cache warmup behaves across bursty chat sessions; expected cold-start token overhead for quantized models; autoscale cooldown policies for Dedicated.
Commercial touchpoints: Finance asked for 36-month amortization scenarios; procurement needs SOW + SOC2 attestation copy before signature.
Next demo: Dedicated sizing walkthrough + cost model v2 scheduled w/ finance and infra (2025-02-25).
